$comment: Suppressions for tools/scan-secrets.py (ADR 0054). Each entry names one finding exactly: its rule, its exact path, and the full sha256 fingerprint the scanner printed — never the matched value. reason says why it is not a credential; accepted_by is a person, not a role or a team. An entry that matches nothing fails the scan as stale. Prefer building a synthetic fixture at runtime over adding an entry here.
